semantics.risk_score: Deterministic composite assessment from current regime, attributed evidence, coverage, and confidence. Higher values indicate higher assessed market risk.
semantics.risk_level: Descriptive classification of current assessed market risk; not a forecast of future returns.
semantics.confidence: Reliability of the risk assessment given upstream evidence and coverage; not probability of a future market outcome.
semantics.recommendation: The engine does not emit BUY/SELL/LONG/SHORT/PAY/EXECUTE recommendations.
